Name: Actual Baby Chicks
Author: Laufente
Description:
[size=3][b]Actual Baby Chicks
[/b]
This simple mod removes the comb from brown, blue and void chicks to make them look like the little babies they are.
It's just a small detail (literally, because wow are those sprites tiny), but it's always bothered me a bit. So, here we are!

Comes with a lighter, less saturated alternative for the blue chick [s]cause I think it's cuter that way[/s].

Decided to update this for 1.6 because why not. (Gets rid of the warning message in SMAPI that the old version displayed if used in 1.6 )

_______________________________________________________

[b]How to install[/b]

1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, if you haven't already.
2. Download this mod.
3. Unzip into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. (If you don't use Vortex)

________________________________________________________

[b]Settings
[/b]
You can disable or enable the mod for each chicken color individually, and switch between the blue chick variants.
I recommend using[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/b], but you can also do it manually instead:
1. Run the game with SMAPI once to generate the file config.json inside the mod's folder.
[size=3][size=3]2. [size=3]Edit the file, and change the value for any chicken to "false" to deactivate the mod for this particual color. [/size]Change the value for "BabyBlueChicken" from [size=3]"[size=3]light[/size][/size]" to "normal"[/size][/size] to switch colors.

[/size]
